timeline.summary: Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹842.22 Cr, net profit ₹119.34 Cr.
Grindwell Norton executed share subscription and power purchase agreements with Sunsure Energy and Murli Solar for renewable energy sourcing.
Grindwell Norton released its analyst presentation detailing FY26 revenue of ₹3,073 Cr and net profit of ₹417 Cr.
Grindwell Norton Limited shared the weblink for its Analyst/Investor Meeting held on May 29, 2026, via THANWARDAS THANWARDAS (Girish T. Shajani).
Q2FY27 results (consolidated): revenue ₹883.67 Cr (+14.1% YoY), net profit to shareholders ₹132.7 Cr (+24.2% YoY).
